source_name: Alaska Division of Elections, 2024 General Election Summary Report - OFFICIAL RESULTS (report time 11/30/2024 4:00:37 PM), U.S. Representative (Internet Archive snapshot); final round from RCV Detailed Report, U.S. Representative, Official results (11/30/2024)
other_sources: https://web.archive.org/web/20250305230928/https://www.elections.alaska.gov/results/24GENR/RCV-USRep.pdf (official RCV tabulation, source of final_round columns)
notes: At-large seat, ranked-choice. First-choice summary (403 of 403 precincts): Begich (REP) 159550, Peltola (DEM) 152828, Howe (AIP) 13010, Hafner (DEM) 3417, write-in 750; Total Votes 329555 = sum of candidates incl. write-ins. Blank and overvoted first choices are EXCLUDED (summary Times Cast = 340981 ballots is not used). RCV tabulation: round 1 shows slightly different counts (Begich 159777, Peltola 152948, Howe 13210, Hafner 3558; continuing 329493; blanks 5788; overvotes 572) because the tabulator skips a single skipped ranking and excludes unresolved write-ins; dem/rep_votes use the summary first-choice counts as instructed. Final round 3: Begich 164861 (51.22%), Peltola 156985 (48.78%), continuing 321846, exhausted 7595, overvotes 624, blanks 5788. The live elections.alaska.gov returned an AWS WAF block (HTTP 405), so archived copies were used; the summary snapshot chosen has the same content digest as captures through Oct 2026. No FEC cross-check: the FEC 2024 workbook URL returned 403.

source_name: Georgia Secretary of State election night reporting (Clarity ENR, election 107231 = Nov 3 2020 presidential recount), summary.json version 273078 (Internet Archive snapshot)
other_sources: https://web.archive.org/web/20230610080607/https://results.enr.clarityelections.com//GA/105369/271927/json/en/summary.json (pre-recount Nov 20 2020 certification: Biden 2474507, Trump 2461837, Jorgensen 62138; superseded); https://www.fec.gov/resources/cms-content/documents/federalelections2020.xlsx (FEC Federal Elections 2020, '2020 Pres General Results' sheet; cross-check: same Biden/Trump/Jorgensen as the recount, plus write-ins totalling 2244, state total 4999960)
notes: Recount figures (recertified Dec 7 2020): Biden (Dem) 2473633, Trump (Rep) 2461854, Jorgensen (Lib) 62229; total_votes = sum of these three = 4997716. The state ENR JSON reports no write-in line. FEC lists 16 certified write-in candidates totalling 2244 (Hawkins 1013, Carroll 701, etc.), which would make the all-candidate total 4999960; not included because it could not be verified in a state document (margin changes by <0.001 pt). The JSON shows PR 154 of TP 159 (a reporting-unit counter) and does not itself say 'certified', but its figures match the recertified totals in FEC exactly. The live Clarity site returned 403, so the archived copy was used.
